# Edge case: every value is above hi. The upper bound is quantized to the edge
# of hi's bucket (~107.6 here), not hi itself: 200..5000 land in overflow, but
# 105 shares hi's bucket and is counted there. The export still labels that
# last finite bucket le="100", and quantiles in it top out at hi, so a value
# above hi is reported as at most 100. Overflow sits above every finite bucket,
# so only the +Inf bucket accumulates it and the upper quantiles pin to hi.

lo 1
hi 100
error_bound 0.1
values 105 200 500 1000 5000
